Title: Ludo World
Description: Experience endless fun with various vibrant environments, where every roll of the dice brings a new challenge. Choose between classic or quick mode, progress along the trophy road, and prove you're the master of the board with every move you make.
Instructions: In this endless Ludo game, players roll dice to move their tokens from the start to the target square in the center, based on the values rolled. Landing on an opponent’s token can send it back to the start. Players can complete sub-quests for extra rewards.

Title: Domino Legend
Description: Dive into the enchanting realm of Domino Legend. Ideal for both veterans and nostalgic players, this online game offers an exciting challenge. Enjoy the beloved Block and Draw formats, and experience the joy of a fast-paced match on your device.
Instructions: A round of domino is played until one player places all of their tiles or until the game is blocked and neither player can make a move. At the beginning the players receive 7 tiles and the one with higher double begins the game. If neither player got a double, then the player with the highest tile begins. The player who earns 100 points first wins.
